title: Exodus 33:19 and Acts 3:19 — mercy and repentance
summary: Exodus 33:19 (the LORD will proclaim His name and show mercy and compassion) shown above the start of Acts 3:19, "Repent, therefore, and turn again, for the blotting out of your sins," with the Greek reference header ΠΡΑΞΕΙΣ 3:19.

text.text: 19 “I will cause all My goodness to pass before you,” the LORD replied, “and I will proclaim My name—the LORD—in your presence. I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
19 Repent, therefore, and turn again, for the blotting out of your sins,
